_notes: THE FLOOR IS PRINTED AND IT IS PRINTED ONCE. "Round to the nearest dollar. Do not enter a negative number. If any line item is a negative number, enter \"0\"." is drawn at y 670.9 x 165.2..576.0 on page 2, above the first total on the form. It is quoted as floor_caption on all four Add-lines totals rather than on the first only, because a floor declared on one line and not its siblings would read as a difference between the lines that the page does not draw.

THE MULTIPLIER IS 0.8 AND IT IS READ OFF THE PAGE. "X .8 = $" is drawn six times on page 3 - twice in the real-estate block at x 125.9..155.9 and four times in the vehicle block at x 115.1..145.1 (three rows plus the (4d) attachment caption). The leaf name is Times_8 and it agrees, which is recorded as agreement and not relied on: 433-A(OIC) carries a cell named Times_7 that the page multiplies by .8, and that is registry entry C02 and the reason this declaration reads the factor off the drawn text.

THE INVESTMENT ROWS CARRY NO MULTIPLIER. The (2a) and (2b) rows print "– $" between the value cell and the loan cell and nothing else. Declared with no factor. The real-estate and vehicle rows print "X .8 = $" and a third money cell for the result. Two shapes that look alike at a glance and are not.

THE VEHICLE TOTAL IS ONE PRINTED CELL WITH TWO DEFINED VALUES. "Total value of vehicle (if the vehicle is leased, enter 0 as the total value)" names a selector that is a printed box on the same row - the Lease/Own pair. Each of the three rows is declared as TWO predicated lines, so exactly one is checked on any filled form and the other is SKIPPED with its reason printed. Declaring only the OWN branch would leave the printed 0 on a leased row unverified while the transcript read clean.

totals.at_most_printed: *You may exclude any equity in income producing assets (except real estate) shown in Section 2 of this form.
totals._why_one_sided_and_not_an_equality: THE ASTERISK. The footnote permits a REDUCTION of Box A by the equity in income-producing assets other than real estate, and Section 2 prints no column marking an asset as income-producing and no cell anywhere holds the excluded amount - so a correct filing can print less than Box A by an amount the form records nowhere, and an equality would fail it. Nothing printed anywhere on this form permits an ADDITION, so the other half of the constraint is sound and is now declared. See adapters/pdf/comparisons.mjs.
totals._what_it_refuses: A page-5 copy that OVERSTATES Box A. That inflates the minimum offer amount on a filed offer in compromise - the taxpayer offers the IRS more than the form computes - and until this line was declared nothing in this engine looked at the cell at all.

_superseded_declaration_kept_verbatim.why_not_checkable: THE ASTERISK. The footnote at y 461.1, x 36.0..452.1 reads "*You may exclude any equity in income producing assets (except real estate) shown in Section 2 of this form." So this cell is Box A MINUS an optional exclusion the taxpayer chooses and the form records nowhere: Section 2 prints no column marking an asset as income-producing, and no cell anywhere holds the excluded amount. A tripwire asserting equality with Box A would fail a correctly filed form that took the exclusion; one accepting anything at or below Box A would refuse almost nothing. 433-A(OIC) prints the analogous cell as "Enter the amount from Box A plus Box B (if applicable)" with NO exclusion footnote, and that one IS checked - the difference is one asterisk and it is the whole difference.

The form records no such marking, so nothing here can check the reduction. If you took the exclusion, keep the working with the return.
_superseded_declaration_kept_verbatim._the_one_sided_check_that_was_considered: This cell can never legitimately EXCEED Box A: the footnote permits an exclusion and nothing on the page permits an addition. A one-sided tripwire is a real constraint and this engine has no construct for one - every declared line is an equality with an optional floor - so declaring it would mean adding a comparison kind to step 11 in a slice. Use whole dollars only." - a value of exactly 0 satisfies the arithmetic whenever both operands are 0 and violates the page; (2) which of Box E and Box F the middle operand copied, which is the payment term and is set on Form 656, Section 4, a form this repo does not hold; (3) the note printed above the whole section: "The multipliers below (12 and 24) and the calculated offer amount do not apply if IRS determines you have the ability to pay your tax debt in full within the legal period to collect."
